Universal 16-Family Developer Workbench, envelope inspector and live code generator.

MODEL ARCHITECTURE & LOADING MODE

Choose between Universal Catalog loading for all built-in model families or direct Parakeet presets.

Universal Catalog Mode

Supports all built-in model families (Parakeet, Orukeet, Whisper, Canary, MedASR, Moonshine, Qwen3-ASR, Wav2Vec2, SenseVoice, GigaAM, Nemotron) via loadBuiltInSpeechModel().

Parakeet Easy Mode

Uses loadSpeechModel() with Parakeet options and dual canonical/native envelope.

Parakeet Native Helper Mode

Uses the direct Parakeet helper with lower-level native response fields for parity verification.

COPYABLE CODE SNIPPET

@asrjs/speech-recognition/builtins
Copy Code
import { PcmAudioBuffer } from '@asrjs/speech-recognition';
import { loadBuiltInSpeechModel } from '@asrjs/speech-recognition/builtins';

const model = await loadBuiltInSpeechModel({
  modelId: 'parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2',
  backend: 'webgpu-hybrid',
});

// Offline / Batch Transcription
const result = await model.transcribe(
  PcmAudioBuffer.fromMono(pcmFloat32, 16000),
  { detail: 'detailed', responseFlavor: 'canonical+native', language: 'en' }
);

// Stateful Streaming (available only when the loaded model supports it)
// model.supportsStreaming is false; the batch transcription above is the supported path.
